leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply Angular CLI commands to generate new components and services for the application.
Implement Capacitor Geolocation API methods to access the device's current GPS coordinates.
Use Angular's HttpClient to make HTTP requests to a restaurant API endpoint.
Construct TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of restaurant data objects.
Execute conditional logic to handle GPS permission states and location errors.
Store retrieved GPS coordinates in component state variables for later use.
Utilize RxJS operators to transform API response data into usable restaurant listings.
Implement Angular template syntax to display restaurant information in the view.
Apply CSS styling to format restaurant cards with images, names, and distances.
Control user interface feedback by displaying loading indicators during API calls.
Define and invoke a function to calculate distances between user location and restaurant coordinates.
Modify component templates to conditionally show error messages when location services fail.
